accueil.sousTitre: Web application design and IT support
accueil.accroche: I build complete web platforms, from the database to the interface, and I keep them running.
accueil.localisation: Libreville, Gabon · Available for freelance work
aPropos.paragraphe1: I am a full-stack JavaScript developer based in Libreville, Gabon. I build complete web applications with the MERN stack (MongoDB, Express, React, Node.js) and TypeScript, following the MVC architecture. I hold a professional bachelor's degree in software engineering and I am currently preparing a master's degree in Software Engineering.
aPropos.paragraphe2: I work as a freelancer. I also install, configure and maintain Windows and Microsoft Office workstations. My project Nody, an e-commerce platform that I designed and built end to end, shows how I work: a clear architecture, a secured API and a responsive interface.
services.web.description: Custom design and development with the MERN stack: responsive interface, secured API and database.
